snippet.title: Abiotic Factor - 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter The Chilling Continuation in Cold Fusion! Abiotic Factor has launched into 1.0!

Available now on Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation Plus Game Catalogue and Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass.

Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.

Steam ▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/427410/Abiotic_Factor/ 
PlayStation ▶ https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012483 
Xbox ▶ https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/abiotic-factor/9p4nv23q6qc2
